related_questions.question: How long does it take to get through security at Tampa airport?

text_blocks.snippet: At Tampa International Airport (TPA), you should generally allow 20 minutes during non-peak times and 45 minutes during peak times to get through security, according to Tampa International Airport. Peak times are typically between 6 a.m. and 9 a.m. and the days before and after holidays.
snippet_highlighted_words: 20 minutes during non-peak times and 45 minutes during peak times

text_blocks.snippet: To ensure a smooth experience, consider these tips:

list.title: Check the latest wait times:
list.snippet: Before heading to the airport, check the TSA wait times on the Way.com website or other sources for real-time updates.

list.title: Arrive early:
list.snippet: Arrive at least two hours before your flight for domestic flights and three hours for international flights, according to Tampa International Airport.

list.title: Be prepared:
list.snippet: Have your boarding pass and ID readily available, and know what items are restricted from carry-on luggage.

list.title: Consider TSA PreCheck:
list.snippet: If you frequently travel, TSA PreCheck can significantly speed up the security process.

list.title: Use the correct checkpoint:
list.snippet: TPA has four security checkpoints, one for each airside, so make sure you head to the right one based on your gate.

list.title: Be aware of peak hours:
list.snippet: Avoid traveling during the busiest times if possible, or allow extra time.

related_questions.question: How much is parking at Tampa airport?

text_blocks.snippet: Parking at Tampa International Airport (TPA) varies in price depending on the lot. The Short Term Garage is $24 per day, the Long Term Garage is $20 per day, and Economy Parking is $14 per day. All garages are covered and well-lit, with easy access to the terminal.

text_blocks.snippet: Here's a breakdown of the parking options:

list.title: Short Term Garage:
list.snippet: Free for the first hour, then $4 for 60-80 minutes, and $2 for each additional 20 minutes. The daily maximum is $24.

list.title: Long Term Garage:
list.snippet: Free for the first hour, then $4 for 60-80 minutes, and $2 for each additional 20 minutes. The daily maximum is $20.

list.title: Economy Parking:
list.snippet: Free for the first 15 minutes, then $1 for 15-20 minutes, and $1 for each additional 20 minutes. The daily maximum is $14.
